rules.title: Product names
rules.fix: Give each sampled product a descriptive title, not just a code.

rules.title: Product type
rules.fix: Fill in the product type. This is not the same field as Shopify product category.

rules.title: Vendor or brand
rules.fix: Add the true manufacturer or brand; do not invent one.

rules.title: Useful descriptions
rules.fix: Describe material, size and use. We flag fewer than 80 plain-text characters as a local heuristic, not a platform requirement.

rules.title: Named variant options
rules.fix: For products with multiple variants, publish option names and values that distinguish each variant.

rules.title: Variant prices
rules.fix: Publish a finite non-negative price for each variant. Currency is checked on the product page.

rules.title: Variant availability
rules.fix: Publish an explicit true or false availability value for each variant. False means sold out, not an error.

rules.title: Barcode evidence
rules.fix: Check manufacturer-assigned GTINs in your admin. Missing public barcodes are unknown, not a failure; never invent identifiers. Invalid published GTIN checksums are flagged.

rules.title: Product images
rules.fix: Publish at least one HTTPS image URL for each product. We check the URL, not the image contents.

rules.title: Image descriptions
rules.fix: Where the public feed exposes alt text, describe the product image. An omitted alt field is unknown; an empty field needs review.

rules.title: Readable JSON-LD
rules.fix: Repair invalid application/ld+json blocks. JSON-LD added only by JavaScript is outside this check.

rules.title: Product structured data
rules.fix: Include a Product or ProductGroup in the initial HTML of the sampled product page. This checker does not inspect Microdata or RDFa.

rules.title: Product name and image
rules.fix: Give every sampled Product, variants included, a name and an HTTP(S) image URL that describe that product. A ProductGroup needs only a name; its variants carry the images.

rules.title: Product offers
rules.fix: Attach Offer or AggregateOffer data to the sampled Product, including through @id references or hasVariant.

rules.title: Price and currency
rules.fix: Use a numeric price and a three-letter currency on each offer. AggregateOffer needs a lowPrice; valid priceSpecification is supported.

rules.title: Offer availability
rules.fix: Use a recognized schema.org availability value on each Offer. AggregateOffer availability is not required here.

rules.title: Structured return policy
rules.fix: Publish a MerchantReturnPolicy in JSON-LD, either on the offer or on your Organization (hasMerchantReturnPolicy), which Google recommends for a policy that covers your whole shop. Include applicableCountry and returnPolicyCategory, plus merchantReturnDays for a finite window, or a merchantReturnLink on the Organization. If an offer carries its own policy, Google uses it instead of the store-wide one, so it must be complete too. We read the initial HTML of the sampled product pages and, where they open, of your home, return, shipping and contact pages. We cannot see return settings made in Google Merchant Center or Search Console; Google gives those precedence over markup, so this finding does not mean Google lacks your policy.

rules.title: Structured shipping
rules.fix: Publish shipping terms in JSON-LD, either as OfferShippingDetails on the offer (shippingDestination, shippingRate and deliveryTime, which Google requires for its shipping details enhancement) or as a ShippingService on your Organization (hasShippingService with shippingConditions and a shippingRate), which Google recommends for terms that cover your whole shop. If an offer carries its own shipping terms, Google uses them instead of the store-wide ones, so they must be complete too. We read the initial HTML of the sampled product pages and, where they open, of your home, return, shipping and contact pages. We cannot see shipping settings made in Google Merchant Center or Search Console; Google gives those precedence over markup, so this finding does not mean Google lacks your shipping terms.

rules.title: Review claims need evidence
rules.fix: If you publish AggregateRating, keep the rating and positive review count valid and backed by real reviews visible to shoppers. We cannot authenticate reviews. No rating is required.

rules.title: Return information
rules.fix: Link to a readable return or refund policy on this shop. We check access and a minimum body, not legal sufficiency.

rules.title: Delivery information
rules.fix: Link to readable shipping information on this shop. We do not verify its accuracy or delivery promises.

rules.title: Contact information
rules.fix: Link to a readable contact page on this shop so shoppers can find a way to reach you.

rules.title: OAI-SearchBot access
rules.fix: Review robots.txt rules for the sampled product paths. Allow OAI-SearchBot if you want ChatGPT search crawling; this does not guarantee inclusion.

rules.title: PerplexityBot access
rules.fix: Review robots.txt for PerplexityBot on the sampled paths. Its search crawler is separate from foundation-model training.

rules.title: ChatGPT-User preference
rules.fix: This is a user-triggered fetcher. A robots.txt preference does not establish whether user-triggered requests work.

rules.title: Google-Extended preference
rules.fix: This token controls Gemini training and some grounding. It does not control inclusion or ranking in Google Search.

rules.title: Optional llms.txt
rules.fix: This proposed context file is optional. Its absence has no score penalty and its presence is not a ranking guarantee.
